parameters.content:
## 01 · Intake → Risk → Triage
The entry point for every assessment.

**Order matters.** Consent gate → deterministic red-flag gate → agent service → reconcile (escalate-only) → persist → route.

If the agent service is down the red-flag gate still routes urgent cases. A model result can raise the tier, never lower it.

assignments.name: vigorConfig
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const d = { agentServiceUrl: 'http://host.docker.internal:8000', internalToken: '', notifyMode: 'DEMO', oncallEmail: 'oncall@example-clinic.ae', escalationSlaMinutes: 60, quietHoursStart: 21, quietHoursEnd: 8, webhookBase: 'http://localhost:5678', envBlocked: true }; try { return { agentServiceUrl: $env.VIGOR_AGENT_SERVICE_URL || d.agentServiceUrl, internalToken: $env.VIGOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '', notifyMode: $env.VIGOR_NOTIFY_MODE || 'DEMO', oncallEmail: $env.VIGOR_ONCALL_EMAIL || d.oncallEmail, escalationSlaMinutes: Number($env.VIGOR_ESCALATION_SLA_MINUTES || 60), quietHoursStart: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_START || 21), quietHoursEnd: Number($env.VIGOR_QUIET_HOURS_END || 8), webhookBase: ($env.WEBHOOK_URL || 'http://localhost:5678/').replace(/\/$/, ''), envBlocked: false }; } catch (e) { return d; } })() }}

nodes.name: Vigor config
nodes.notes: The only node that reads $env. Needs N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false, and falls back to defaults with envBlocked:true if that is missing.

nodes.name: Validate envelope
nodes.notes: Rejects anything that does not match the event contract. No clinical logic here.

nodes.name: Load consent ledger
nodes.notes: The ledger is append-only, so we read it all and let the gate decide.

nodes.name: Consent gate · ASSESSMENT
nodes.notes: No consent, no processing. The refusal itself is audited.

nodes.name: Red-flag gate (deterministic)
nodes.notes: Runs before any model call. Pure functions over the submitted answers. Defined in n8n/src/shared.mjs and reviewed in docs/06-clinical-safety.md.

nodes.name: Agent service · score & triage
nodes.notes: Unavailability is expected, not exceptional. onError continues so the reconcile step can fall back to the deterministic gate.

nodes.name: Reconcile · escalate only
nodes.notes: The safety rule in one place: take the engine tier, then clamp it upward to the deterministic minimum. Never downward. Record which source won.

nodes.name: Route by tier
nodes.notes: Acuity routing. URGENT hands off to workflow 02 immediately.

nodes.name: Hand off to 02 · escalation
nodes.notes: Deliberately a webhook call, not a sub-workflow: the escalation becomes its own execution record with its own retry and SLA clock.

nodes.name: Build 200 response
nodes.notes: The response is what the results screen renders. Screening, not diagnosis.
